src: https://acvote.alamedacountyca.gov/acvote-assets/02_election_information/PDFs/20261103/Voter%20Information%20Guide/vig_nov2026_eng.pdf (pdf pages 40-631 = sample ballots; ballot type printed in each page footer as "BT<n>")
note: The county Composite VIG prints one bilingual (English/Spanish) sample ballot per ballot type: 46 ballot types, labeled BT1..BT263 (numbers are not contiguous). Each ballot type occupies 12 consecutive PDF pages (Cards A, B, C front and back plus blanks) or 16 pages when it has a ranked-choice card (Albany, Berkeley, Oakland). The first page of each group lacks the BT footer but starts the group; page groups are contiguous. Each footer also prints a 6-digit number (e.g., "475700 (0361) - BT1") that is the Precinct_ID of a Nov 3 2026 consolidated precinct in the county GIS layer (all 46 verified among the 627 precincts); I treat it as the representative precinct the sample ballot was generated for. Contest_ids are county_race_id values from contests.json. Contests were assigned to a ballot type when ALL of the contest's qualified candidates' names appear in that ballot type's decoded page text (the sample-ballot text uses an obfuscated font; fallback by surname for two accented-name contests); measures were assigned by matching the county question text. All 9 statewide offices, exactly 1 US House and 1 Assembly contest appear on every ballot type, State Senate (10th District) on 17 of 46, and RCV contests appear exactly on the 10 types that have an RCV card. All 28 measures were found. The VIG and the county pages I checked do NOT map ballot types to cities, areas, or precincts, so `areas` is empty for every type. As hints only, `areas_derived_from_contents` and `districts_derived_from_contents` list jurisdictions/districts of the contests and measures printed on that ballot (derived, not county-stated), and `sample_precinct_gis` gives the city(ies) for the single sample precinct from the county ROV city-boundary and precinct GIS layers (a hint for that one precinct, not a coverage list). Unplaced: contest 28 (Peralta CCD Trustee Area 1 Short Term) is on no ballot type. Measure RTM (regional) is printed on all 46 types. Judicial retention items (Supreme Court and First District Court of Appeal) and state propositions are identical on all ballot types and are not in contest_ids.

measure_universe.note: RTM is the regional transit measure; others are local.
